research: Builds on this course's own Chapter 1 lesson on Business Processes in Salesforce (Lesson 1) and its coverage of time-based/scheduled automation actions.
note: Case-study lesson built around a clearly labeled fictional company (Briarcliff Networks) and an invented but realistic SLA-escalation scenario. No real company, org, or data is represented. Consistent with this catalog's documented non-visual exception (scripts/course-build/SCREENSHOTS.md): a case-study walkthrough has no single real UI screen that represents it, so slides use steps/code cards instead of screenshots.
